note: ui.8starlabs.com — component registry with a docs page /docs/components/<name> and an llm mirror /llm/components/<name> (same slugs, so both templates produce one id and the first page in sitemap order — the docs one — fills the url). 15 of the 62 url-less items attach (button, flip-clock, heatmap, json-viewer, …); the others are demo items (button-demo, flip-clock-size-demo, …) attached to their component as examples and have no page of their own. robots.txt allows / (only /api/ and /_next/ disallowed).
